status_definitions.fixed: Implemented and tested locally for the stated native workflow or client boundary; not deployed and not a claim of complete legacy operating cutover.
status_definitions.open: A part of the original supported write/read/UI/schema contract remains unfixed or its acceptance is incomplete. Native partial fixes/guards are recorded without closing the whole finding.
status_definitions.intentionally_deferred: Directly reserved by the user for future work; interim native controls and missing acceptance are explicit.

findings.conclusion: Fixed locally for explicit shared product/SKU linkage and independent store ownership.

findings.original_title: Polling and late saves can replace local drafts or cross location UI state
findings.conclusion: Fixed locally for App state/revisions and retained sales/form drafts.
findings.current_assessment: Restaurant/session generations guard every App collection/sales acknowledgement, state callback and refresh. A→B→A and old callbacks cannot update the new scope. Writes capture their own revision; outstanding writes block stale overlapping replacements and invalidate overtaken reads. Sales polling preserves dirty inputs and original revision; changed revisions block overwrite. Debounce timers clear on firing/unmount, no unmount duplicate write occurs, and retained drafts require explicit save on return. Main App navigation plus component-level races are tested.
findings.next_step_or_limit: Granular backend concurrency remains R17; direct legacy workflow draft contracts remain R07/Step 4. Current form drafts are session memory, not a persistent offline queue. No production/browser proof claimed.
findings.original_acceptance: Polling cannot erase unsaved edits; a delayed old-store save cannot change the selected store's data/revision; switching tabs causes no duplicate completed save.
findings.evidence_limit: Current local source verified. Current catalog/receiving/entry checks and synthetic shared-catalog restore; prior prep/recovery evidence preserved separately. No deployment or full cutover claim.
